A '''repulsorlift platoon''' was a formation in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Organization==
Three [[repulsorlift squad]]s, one [[heavy weapons repulsorlift squad]], and a command element, comprising fifty-six personnel, formed a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]]. The command element contained two light transport vehicles that had been modified with heavier [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and a greater repulsorlift output. A support vehicle carrying spare parts was also attached to the platoon, and was manned by four crew who doubled as mechanics, and eight [[Technician/Legends|technicians]].<ref name="ISB" />

A repulsorlift platoon could be augmented by the addition of two extra repulsorlift squads, and two extra heavy weapons repulsorlift squads.<ref name="ISB2" />
